title: Farm Real Estate Loans: Combined Loan-to-Value Test Across a Member's Mortgages
content:
Because the association's farm real estate mortgages carry a cross-default and future-advance clause, a member's Farm Real Estate Loans are also tested together.

## The test

1. **When it is run.** When a new loan is closed, or when a parcel is released on sale, on condemnation or as a farmstead split.
2. **What is measured.** The combined principal of all the member's farm real estate loans in active or nonaccrual status, divided by the combined value of all parcels still mortgaged to them, with the transaction being considered applied, expressed as a percentage rounded to 2 decimals.
3. **The limit.** That percentage may not exceed the lowest "largest principal after a release" percentage among the products of those loans. A percentage equal to that lowest limit meets the test.
4. **When the test fails.** The release or closing proceeds only after the member pays principal down on the loan concerned until the test is met.
5. **Payoff.** A release on payoff is never tested.

## Judgement table

| Event | Tested? |
|---|---|
| A new farm real estate loan closes | yes |
| A parcel is released on sale | yes |
| A parcel is released on condemnation | yes |
| A parcel is released as a farmstead split | yes |
| Parcels are released on payoff | never |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

A member holds two loans, both in active status. Loan one, on the FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage, has USD 300000 of principal and parcels still mortgaged worth USD 500000; loan two, on the FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage, has USD 450000 of principal and parcels worth USD 600000. The member asks to release from loan two a parcel sold for a price that, applied as release proceeds, lowers its principal to USD 330000, while the parcel's USD 150000 of value leaves the mortgage.

- With the release applied, combined principal is USD 630000 and combined value still mortgaged is USD 950000; 630000 divided by 950000 is 66.32 percent.
- The products' limits are 75 percent and 70 percent; the lowest is 70 percent.
- 66.32 percent does not exceed 70 percent: the test is met.

Had the combined percentage come to exactly 70.00, the test would still be met; at 70.01 it would fail, and the release would proceed only after a principal paydown on the loan concerned bringing the combined figure to 70.00 or below.
